summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing Fort Technology Inc.'s audited financials, MD&A, and a press release about a product authorization. It also discloses warrant exercise price adjustments to $1.5458 per ordinary share and the full exercise of two warrants. No special-situation transaction (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, spin-off, tender offer, restructuring, delisting) is present. The filing is a routine periodic report with ministerial warrant adjustments, not a transformative event. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K corresponds to a U.S. Form 8-K but lacks any material definitive agreement or corporate action requiring classification under special situations.
